title: Runtime Verification of Multiple Natural Language Criteria for Agent Governance
title_zh: 面向 AI 智能体治理的多条自然语言准则运行时验证
abstract_en: AI agents are governed by hundreds of natural language criteria, yet existing verifiers cannot efficiently evaluate an agent's output against a large set of such criteria and report which are satisfied, violated, or inapplicable. We introduce the VFM, a tree-attention verifier that encodes the shared context and target text, and scores N natural language criteria in parallel, returning independent per-criterion ternary verdicts. The VFM is pretrained on CriteriaBank, a corpus of 394K (context, target, criterion, verdict) tuples spanning over 321K distinct criterion strings. A finetuned VFM-4B outperforms GPT-5.4 on a synthetic governance benchmark. On the DynaBench multi-criterion benchmark, it outperforms DynaGuard-4B on trace-level failure detection, and its per-criterion verdicts localize the violated rule and support focused escalation to a larger chain-of-thought judge. We show that CriteriaBank pretraining improves cross-domain transfer, particularly in the low-data regime, while matching a strong direct-finetuning control at full data. On a single H100, VFM-4B evaluates 1,000 criteria against a 4K-token context in under 2s at <11 GB VRAM, making it suitable for runtime verification.
abstract_zh: AI 智能体往往受数百条自然语言准则约束，但现有验证器难以高效判断其输出对每条准则是满足、违反还是不适用。本文提出基于树状注意力（tree attention）的验证器 VFM：只需对共享上下文和待验证文本编码一次，即可并行评估 N 条准则，并为每条准则独立给出三分类判定。VFM 在 CriteriaBank 上预训练，该语料包含 39.4 万组（上下文、待验证文本、准则、判定）四元组，覆盖超过 32.1 万种不同的准则文本。微调后的 VFM-4B 在合成治理基准上优于 GPT-5.4，在 DynaBench 上的轨迹级失败检测中优于 DynaGuard-4B。逐条判定还可定位被违反的规则，以便将相关判定交由更大的思维链（chain-of-thought）裁判模型复核。CriteriaBank 预训练能改善跨域迁移，尤其是在标注数据较少时；使用全量数据时，其表现与强直接微调基线相当。在单张 H100 上，VFM-4B 针对 4K token 的上下文验证 1,000 条准则耗时不到 2 秒，显存占用低于 11 GB。
key_points_zh: VFM 复用共享上下文与待验证文本的编码，并行输出每条准则的独立判定：满足、违反或不适用。
VFM-4B 在合成治理基准上优于 GPT-5.4，在 DynaBench 的轨迹级失败检测中优于 DynaGuard-4B；逐条判定还能定位违规规则，支持定向复核。
CriteriaBank 预训练主要提升低数据场景下的跨域迁移；使用全量数据时，表现与强直接微调基线相当。
单张 H100 上，VFM-4B 针对 4K token 上下文验证 1,000 条准则耗时不到 2 秒，显存占用低于 11 GB。

llm_assessment.comment: Parallel per-rule verdicts make large policy sets practical for runtime governance, though benchmark results do not yet establish reliability in production.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 逐条并行判定让大规模规则集可用于运行时治理，但基准结果尚不能证明其在生产环境中的可靠性。
